title: TypeScript test floor
root_cause_confirmed: test and test:integration were mutually recursive at the root level (test:integration's 'pnpm run test --workspaces' re-triggered the root test script), appending --workspaces --if-present indefinitely. Before fix: 300s timeout, ~1600 repeated invocations, zero test-framework output.

before.verdict: refusal, not success — zero tests ever executed

after.verdict: real execution — pnpm -r bails at the first package with a genuine failure, this is correct pnpm default behavior, not a defect in this fix

unrelated_pre_existing_bug_surfaced.note: the test suite expects a command file that doesn't exist on disk — 5 failing assertions all stem from this one missing file. Not fixed as part of GALL-005 (out of scope — this checkpoint's job was to make pnpm test execute real tests, which it now does; it correctly surfaced a real bug rather than hiding it)

ci_impact: none — .github/workflows/{test,wasm-build}.yml already scope test:integration to cwd=wasm4pm/, a separate npm sub-project unaffected by the root-level cycle this fix addresses
known_non_target: examples/zoe-la has a deliberate exit-1 stub test, expected to fail, not in scope to fix here
test_integration_after_fix: repointed at test:e2e, which only examples/web-dashboard and examples/interview-assist define today — becomes a fast no-op for everything else via --if-present, which is the honest fix rather than pretending it does more
